title: V: Add reviewer Playwright cases and matching click checks
public_pr_body:
AG: reviewer browser PR now targets the #247 candidate branch so its application and 145/146 release setup are present. Local combination had no conflicts. Diff against the new base contains browser/support tests, configs, manual steps and CI wiring, not application feature changes. Assumption: reviewing against the actual candidate is safer than keeping an un-runnable feature-less #227 base. No GitHub merge.

The integration job runs exactly:

```sh
REVIEWER_REQUIRE_DATABASE=1 E2E_SKIP_BUILD=1 npx playwright test -c playwright.reviewer.config.ts
```

All 10 cases collect. The ordinary runner delegates reviewer/ to this explicit step with its provider mocks; the reviewer config clears the ignore. Required-database mode fails without a backend instead of skipping green. Integration trigger/Ready-label policy unchanged; no label added or workflow dispatched.

12 targeted unit tests, typecheck and targeted lint passed. Collection lists 10 tests/4 files; required mode correctly refuses the absent backend. Runtime browser/DB checks NOT RUN here, no SQL applied or real provider called. Read tests/e2e/reviewer/README.md for the full conditions and prerequisites.
